effect_cn: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以将一张手牌扣置于你装备区里的【木牛流马】下，然后你可以将此装备移动到一名其他角色的装备区里；你可以如手牌般使用或打出【木牛流马】下的牌。
effect_en: Once per Play Phase, you may place 1 hand card face-down beneath [Wooden Ox], then you may move this card to another character's Equipment Zone. You may use or play cards stored beneath [Wooden Ox] as though they were hand cards.

faq.a_cn: 不算。储备牌不在手牌区，不受针对手牌的技能影响（如弃置、拼点等），只有在可以「使用或打出」手牌的时机才能动用储备牌。
faq.q_en: Do cards stored under [Wooden Ox] count as hand cards?
faq.a_en: No. Stored cards are not in the hand-card area and are unaffected by skills that target hand cards (such as discarding or pitching). They can only be drawn upon at moments that allow you to use or play a hand card.

faq.q_cn: 【木牛流马】可以储存多少张牌？
faq.a_cn: 此版本未规定储存总数上限；每个出牌阶段至多放入一张。
faq.q_en: How many cards can be stored under [Wooden Ox]?
faq.a_en: This version specifies no total storage limit. Only 1 card may be stored per Play Phase.

faq.q_cn: 把【木牛流马】传给别人时，储备牌也一起转移吗？
faq.a_cn: 视情况而定。若【木牛流马】是从装备区移动到另一个装备区（如通过本身效果、甘露、巧变等），储备牌随之一并转移。若【木牛流马】进入装备区以外的区域（如被顺手牵羊牵走后进入手牌区，或被过河拆桥弃置），储备牌全部置入弃牌堆。
faq.q_en: When [Wooden Ox] moves to another character, do stored cards transfer too?
faq.a_en: It depends. If [Wooden Ox] moves from one Equipment Zone to another (via its own effect, 〖Sweet Dew〗, 〖Agile Maneuver〗, etc.), all stored cards transfer with it. If [Wooden Ox] enters any area outside an Equipment Zone (e.g. taken into a hand by [Steal], or discarded by [Dismantle]), all stored cards are placed into the Discard Pile.

faq.q_cn: 可以不放入储备牌，发动【木牛流马】自身的效果将其移动吗？
faq.a_cn: 不可以。发动【木牛流马】自身的效果时，必须先将一张手牌扣置于其下，才能选择是否将其移动至另一名角色的装备区。其他牌或技能的效果仍可移动【木牛流马】。
faq.q_en: Can [Wooden Ox] be moved by its own effect without first storing a card?
faq.a_en: No. To move [Wooden Ox] with its own effect, you must first place a hand card face-down beneath it. Other cards or skills may still move [Wooden Ox].

faq.q_cn: 可以使用储备牌发动武将的转化技能（如〖武圣〗、〖龙胆〗）吗？
faq.a_cn: 可以。任何允许「将手牌当作其他牌使用或打出」的转化技能，均可以选择储备牌发动，例如〖武圣〗、〖龙胆〗等。
faq.q_en: Can stored cards be used to activate a general's Conversion Skill (such as 〖Saint of War〗 or 〖Dragon's Courage〗)?
faq.a_en: Yes. Any Conversion Skill that allows you to use or play a hand card as another card can be activated using a stored card.

faq.q_cn: 大乔的〖流离〗或小乔的〖天香〗可以使用储备牌发动吗？
faq.a_cn: 不可以。这类技能需要「弃置」牌，而储备牌只能被「使用或打出」，无法被弃置。
faq.q_en: Can Da Qiao's 〖Displaced〗 or Xiao Qiao's 〖Celestial Fragrance〗 be activated using stored cards?
faq.a_en: No. Those skills require discarding a card, and stored cards can only be used or played — they cannot be discarded.

effect_cn: 锁定技，你于回合内使用基本牌无距离限制且造成的伤害和回复的体力+1；当你于回合外使用或打出基本牌时，你摸一张牌；此牌离开你的装备区后移出游戏。
effect_en: Locked Skill: During your turn, Basic cards you use have no distance restriction, and the damage they deal and the HP they recover are each increased by 1. When you use or play a Basic card outside of your turn, draw 1 card. When this card leaves your Equipment Zone, it is instead Removed from the Game.

faq.q_cn: 【霹雳车】离开装备区后为何被销毁而不是进入弃牌堆？
faq.a_cn: 这是该牌的特殊规则。一旦离开装备区（无论是被弃置、被夺取还是其他原因），牌直接从游戏中移除，不进入弃牌堆。
faq.q_en: Why is [Catapult] destroyed rather than discarded when it leaves the Equipment Zone?
faq.a_en: This is a special rule on the card. Regardless of how it leaves the Equipment Zone (discarded, stolen, etc.), it is removed from the game entirely and does not enter the Discard Pile.

effect_cn: 出牌阶段开始时，你可以视为使用一张【杀】，此【杀】对目标角色造成伤害后，你弃置其一张牌（每次修改选择一项：1.此【杀】无距离限制；2.此【杀】可多指定一个目标；3.此【杀】对目标角色造成伤害后，你多弃置其一张牌）；此牌离开你的装备区后移出游戏。
effect_en: At the start of your Play Phase, you may use a virtual [Kill]. After this [Kill] deals damage to a target, discard 1 of that character's cards. Each time this card is upgraded through Zhang Fen's 〖Breach the Fortification〗, choose one modification: 1. this [Kill] has no distance restriction; 2. this [Kill] may target 1 additional character; 3. after this [Kill] deals damage to a target, discard 1 additional card from that character. When this card leaves your Equipment Zone, it is Removed from the Game.

faq.q_cn: 其他角色装备【大攻车】后，可以升级它吗？
faq.a_cn: 不能。【大攻车】只能由张奋通过〖陷筑〗升级，宝物本身不提供升级能力。
faq.q_en: Can another character upgrade [Siege Engine] after equipping it?
faq.a_en: No. Only Zhang Fen can upgrade it through 〖Breach the Fortification〗. The treasure itself does not grant an upgrade ability.

faq.q_cn: 【大攻车】的五次升级上限是每个选项各五次吗？
faq.a_cn: 不是。每张【大攻车】通过〖陷筑〗升级的次数合计至多为五次，无论三个选项如何组合；每次选择任一选项都计入这个总上限。
faq.q_en: Can each of [Siege Engine]'s three options be upgraded five times?
faq.a_en: No. Each [Siege Engine] can receive at most five upgrades in total through 〖Breach the Fortification〗, regardless of the combination of options chosen. Every upgrade counts toward that shared limit.

effect_cn: 一名角色的回合结束时，若你的手牌数小于体力值，你可以摸两张牌，然后弃置此牌；此牌离开你的装备区后移出游戏。
effect_en: At the end of any character's turn, if your hand card count is less than your HP Value, you may draw 2 cards, then discard this card. When this card leaves your Equipment Zone, it is instead Removed from the Game.

effect_cn: 其他角色的回合结束时，若其本回合使用过非基本牌，你可以令其交给你一张牌，然后弃置此牌；此牌离开你的装备区后移出游戏。
effect_en: At the end of another character's turn, if they used any non-Basic card this turn, you may have them give you 1 card, then discard this card. When this card leaves your Equipment Zone, it is instead Removed from the Game.

effect_cn: 其他角色的回合结束时，若其本回合未造成过伤害，你可以令其弃置两张牌，然后弃置此牌；此牌离开你的装备区后移出游戏。
effect_en: At the end of another character's turn, if they dealt no damage this turn, you may have them discard 2 cards, then discard this card. When this card leaves your Equipment Zone, it is instead Removed from the Game.

effect_cn: 锁定技，出牌阶段结束时，你将手牌摸至手牌上限(至多摸至五张)；此牌离开装备区后移出游戏。
effect_en: Locked Skill: At the end of your Play Phase, draw until your hand contains cards equal to your Hand Limit or 5, whichever is lower. When this card leaves your Equipment Zone, it is instead Removed from the Game.

effect_cn: 判定阶段开始前，你可以选择一项：1.跳过本回合判定阶段；2.跳过本回合的弃牌阶段；此牌离开装备区后移出游戏。
effect_en: Before your Judgment Phase begins, you may choose one: 1. Skip your Judgment Phase this turn; 2. Skip your Discard Phase this turn. When this card leaves your Equipment Zone, it is instead Removed from the Game.

effect_cn: 当你受到伤害时，你可以弃置等于此伤害值的牌，然后防止此伤害；此牌离开装备区后移出游戏。
effect_en: When you would take X damage, you may discard X cards to prevent it. When this card leaves your Equipment Zone, it is instead Removed from the Game.

effect_cn: 锁定技，当你从装备区失去【孔明灯】时，回复1点体力。任意角色处于濒死状态时，你可以将你装备区的【孔明灯】当【桃】使用
effect_en: Locked Skill: When you lose [Kongming Lantern] from your Equipment Zone, recover 1 HP. When any character is in the Verge of Death State, you may use [Kongming Lantern] from your Equipment Zone as a [Peach].

faq.q_cn: 将【孔明灯】当【桃】救其他角色时，谁回复体力？
faq.a_cn: 你因失去装备区里的【孔明灯】回复1点体力；该濒死角色在【桃】正常生效时回复1点体力。两项回复分别结算，且均不超过各自的体力上限。
faq.q_en: Who recovers when [Kongming Lantern] is used as [Peach] to save another character?
faq.a_en: You recover 1 HP for losing it from your Equipment Zone. The dying character recovers 1 HP if the [Peach] takes effect normally. Resolve the two recoveries separately, each capped by its recipient's Max HP.

effect_cn: 锁定技，当你失去装备区的【青囊书】时，你回复体力至上限。
effect_en: Locked Skill: When you lose [Hua Tuo's Scripture] from your Equipment Zone, recover HP up to your Max HP.

effect_cn: 出牌阶段，你可以弃置一张装备牌摸三张牌。
effect_en: During your Play Phase, you may discard 1 Equipment card to draw 3 cards.

effect_cn: 结束阶段开始时，你可以摸一张牌。
锁定技，当你受到伤害后，将【玉玺】置入弃牌堆。
effect_en: At the start of your End Phase, you may draw 1 card.
Locked Skill: After you take damage, place [Imperial Seal] into the Discard Pile.

faq.q_cn: 伤害被防止或失去体力会触发【玉玺】吗？
faq.a_cn: 不会。此效果须在你实际受到伤害后触发；被防止的伤害及体力流失均不满足此条件。
faq.q_en: Does prevented damage or HP loss trigger [Imperial Seal]?
faq.a_en: No. This effect triggers after you actually take damage. Prevented damage and HP loss do not satisfy that condition.
